entries.name: XMRig
entries.description: XMRig is the most widely deployed Monero miner in cryptojacking campaigns. It is legitimate open-source software, but on a machine nobody deliberately set up for mining its presence means someone else is spending your electricity and CPU.

entries.name: XMR-Stak
entries.description: XMR-Stak is a Monero/Cryptonight miner frequently dropped by cryptojacking loaders.

entries.name: cpuminer (minerd)
entries.description: The cpuminer daemon, historically dropped by worms that brute-force SSH and Redis.

entries.name: cpuminer
entries.description: Generic CPU mining binary used across many cryptojacking families.

entries.name: CGMiner
entries.description: ASIC/GPU mining software. Legitimate for deliberate mining rigs; unexpected on a personal machine.

entries.name: BFGMiner
entries.description: ASIC/FPGA mining software. Unexpected on a personal machine.

entries.name: ethminer
entries.description: Ethash GPU miner, commonly repurposed for unauthorised GPU mining.

entries.name: PhoenixMiner
entries.description: Closed-source GPU miner distributed with cracked software and game mods.

entries.name: NBMiner
entries.description: GPU miner bundled into pirated installers and 'optimiser' downloads.

entries.name: lolMiner
entries.description: GPU miner used both legitimately and in silent-mining bundles.

entries.name: TeamRedMiner
entries.description: AMD GPU miner seen in unauthorised mining deployments.

entries.name: SRBMiner
entries.description: Multi-algorithm miner used in cryptojacking bundles.

entries.name: nanominer
entries.description: Multi-algorithm miner distributed by nanopool, frequently repackaged by cryptojackers.

entries.name: NiceHash miner
entries.description: NiceHash mining client. Legitimate if the owner installed it deliberately; otherwise it is mining for someone else's account.

entries.name: kdevtmpfsi
entries.description: The Kinsing malware's miner payload. The name deliberately imitates a kernel thread; a real kernel thread never lives in /tmp or /var/tmp.

entries.name: Kinsing loader
entries.description: Kinsing is a Go-based cryptojacking loader that installs the kdevtmpfsi miner and spreads to other hosts.

entries.name: Sysrv-hello botnet
entries.description: Sysrv-hello is a cryptojacking worm that mines Monero and spreads across the local network.

entries.name: dbused (miner masquerade)
entries.description: Miner payload masquerading as the D-Bus daemon (the real service is 'dbus-daemon').

entries.name: mshelper
entries.description: macOS adware/miner payload that pins a CPU core at 100% and is installed by fake Flash Player updates.

entries.name: OSAMiner
entries.description: macOS Monero miner distributed inside pirated games and software, hidden in run-only AppleScripts.

entries.name: MoneroOcean installer
entries.description: The MoneroOcean setup script installs XMRig as a service under an attacker's wallet.

entries.name: Generic coin miner
entries.description: Binary or service explicitly named as a coin miner.
